summary: Ukrainian forces conducted drone attacks on Russian naval assets in the Black Sea, targeting tankers linked to the 'shadow fleet' while Russian forces launched missile strikes on Kyiv and other cities. The Ukrainian government announced a new cabinet lineup following the dismissal of Defense Minister Fedorov, with the EU seeking clarification on his removal. Both sides exchanged the bodies of deceased servicemen, with Ukraine receiving 501 and Russia 31.
key_points: Ukrainian SBU forces attacked Russian tankers in the Black Sea using maritime drones, which Russian aviation failed to intercept with gunfire or bombs (Source: @UkraineNow/82689).
Defense Minister Fedorov was dismissed by President Zelensky, with the EU expressing surprise and requesting an explanation for his removal (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31671).

Russia launched missile strikes on Kyiv's Darnitsky district, hitting power plants and depots, while drone attacks targeted Crimea and civilian infrastructure in Engels (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31672).
Ukraine exchanged the bodies of 501 deceased soldiers with Russia, which received 31 in return (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31670).
Russian forces used three Kalibr missiles to attack Zaporizhzhia, killing three people and causing fires and building collapses (Source: @UkraineNow/82703).
Ukrainian drones with AI technology reportedly reduced Russian conscripts' survival time on battlefields to 20–30 minutes (Source: @UkraineNow/82690).
The general director of a defense company was detained in Ukraine for storing ammunition in unsuitable hangars near residential areas (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31678).
Russian drone attacks injured civilians in Belgorod and Kursk regions, including a man in Masychovo and a driver in Maksimovka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31672).

sections.threat_assessment: Ukrainian drone operations, particularly those involving AI technology, pose a significant threat to Russian forces, reducing their battlefield survivability. Russian missile and drone strikes on Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia indicate continued targeting of critical infrastructure. The dismissal of Defense Minister Fedorov may signal strategic shifts in Ukraine's military leadership, potentially affecting coordination. The EU's concern over Fedorov's removal suggests potential diplomatic tensions. Russian forces continue to face challenges in intercepting Ukrainian drones, as seen in the Black Sea attacks.
sections.regional_response: The EU has requested an explanation from Zelensky regarding Fedorov's dismissal, highlighting concerns over Ukraine's defense strategy. Russia's continued missile strikes on Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia demonstrate sustained pressure on Ukrainian infrastructure. The detention of a defense company director in Ukraine underscores internal scrutiny of military logistics. Russian forces in Belgorod and Kursk regions face ongoing drone attacks, causing civilian casualties. The exchange of deceased soldiers reflects ongoing humanitarian efforts amid intensified hostilities.
